performance.verdict: CPL crisis is real; GBP collapse and 5 overdue SOW blockers threaten renewal.

findings.text: CPL spiked 46.68% in 7d with spend nearly flat (-3.74%), meaning leads fell from ~19 to ~12 in the window — efficiency is broken, not budget.
3-day signal (Sep 6–8): leads totalled 12 vs 10 in prior 3 days (Sep 3–5) — marginal uptick, but both windows are well below the Aug 12–18 daily avg of ~4.3/day. No recovery confirmed.
GBP actions dropped 100% for 8 consecutive days (Sep 1–8, 0 actions/day) after averaging 8.6/day Aug 12–31 — channel is dark and organic referral pressure has collapsed.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Jul 23 renewal tracking; latest: Aug 31 dashboard + renewal decision) — scoreboard is untrusted and client walk risk is active.
BWS Retargeting campaign consumed $405.97 of $789.05 (51%) in 28 days; with leads falling -34.37%, retargeting audience may be exhausted — fatigue probable on the top spend line.

suggestions.text: Restore GBP posting cadence immediately; 8 days of 0 actions is a confirmed channel outage cutting top-of-funnel.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 8 consecutive days (Sep 1–8), down from an average of 8.6 actions/day in August — this is a confirmed channel outage, not a slow week. Assign whoever owns GBP content to publish at minimum 2 posts and verify the profile is not suspended or flagged. Success check: GBP actions > 5/day for 3 consecutive days by Sep 12.

suggestions.text: Inject 1–2 new Meta creatives into BWS Retargeting; $405.97 of 28-day spend on a shrinking retargeting pool signals audience exhaustion.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS Instant Leads Retargeting campaign has absorbed $405.97 (51% of all Meta spend) over 28 days while leads fell 34.37% and CPL rose 46.68% — a probable fatigue pattern. Introduce 1–2 new creative variants (different hook or offer angle) without changing the audience or budget. Success check: CPL returns below the Aug 12–18 implicit baseline (~$5–7 range from series data) within 7 days of launch, i.e., by Sep 16.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; Aug 31 dashboard and renewal decision are 9 days past due.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue, the most critical being the Aug 31 dashboard live item and the August scoreboard trusted / renewal decision — both 9 days past due on a one-month prove-it contract. The client's stated walk condition is unmet scoreboards, and GHL returned a 401 error this cycle so pipeline data is also blind. Nacer and Sohib must triage all five items and confirm status by Sep 11. Success check: each milestone marked complete or rescheduled with a new committed date in Monday by Sep 11.
